name: Daily market dataset
usage: Historical analysis and earlier prediction experiments
limitations: The team supplied stablecoin_final_market_data.xlsx, labelled Coin Metrics. This link is the documentation entry point, not a verified download URL for the workbook. Original query parameters and retrieval time remain to be supplied.

name: Historical OHLCVT market data
limitations: USDT/USD and USDC/USD hourly observations support daily features and exploratory intraday labels. A threshold touch on one exchange does not establish a market-wide severe depeg.

name: Federal Funds Effective Rate · DFF
limitations: Macro control variable. The downloaded vintage does not establish historical point-in-time availability.

name: 3-Month Treasury Bill Rate · DTB3
limitations: Secondary-market rate on a discount basis. Do not substitute rates with other maturities or yield conventions.

name: CBOE Volatility Index · VIXCLS
limitations: Market volatility control. FRED distributes the series; Cboe is its original source.

name: USDC reserve and examination reports
limitations: Used to check reserves, cash and circulating liabilities. Reporting dates, signature dates and publication dates differ. These reports were not admitted as verified point-in-time prediction features.

name: February 2023 USDC Examination Report
limitations: Snapshot dated 28 February 2023, signed 30 March 2023, after the event. Publication timing remains unverified. Used retrospectively for the SVB–USDC simulation, not as established pre-crisis information.

name: USDT reserve and assurance reports
limitations: Collected reports do not imply an implemented historical USDT reserve simulation. The earlier USDT stress-test starting balance was hypothetical.

name: Historical candles and cross-exchange checks
limitations: USDT checks are available; some USDC requests returned no comparable data. This link documents the API. Exact request URLs are recorded in coinbase_manifest.json.
